summary: Live probe against Open VSX registry completed in 17014ms. Hops E1..E5 succeed (VSIX downloaded 6.8MB, unpacked 2382 files, manifest validated). Hop E6 FAILS with HOST_REGISTRATION_FAILED because the extension runtime host strictly rejects non-built-in extensions (!extension.isBuiltIn || executionState !== 'built-in') and worker isolates only execute the 5 hardcoded built-in modules. The marketplace implementation is currently METADATA-ONLY.
